title: Stack It
reference: pick_up turn_left turn_left drop turn_right pick_up turn_left drop
hints: The pad needs two crates, one on top of the other. You can drop a crate onto another crate.
8 commands. You never need to walk: turn to face each crate, then the pad.
pick_up, turn_left, turn_left, drop, turn_right, pick_up, turn_left, drop

story.intro: PATCH: "Stack two cells on that pad and the lobby lights come back."
